NUMFRAC.description: Source number fraction against reference catalog must be > 0.05

SHIFTED.description: Image must NOT have a shifted-overscan band

STDNUMB.description: Zero-point stars from Photometry must be >= 5

EZP_AUTO.description: Zero-point error from Photometry must be < 0.2 mag

PNTGDEV.description: Pointing deviation from OBJCTRA/OBJCTDEC must be < 15 arcmin

PADEV.description: Field rotation deviation from TARGET_PA (mod 180) must be < 10 deg
